title: G34 · 拒绝
body: I changed only `matMul`, replacing its row-oriented transpose with cache-blocked paired-column panels and paired-row left panels while retaining the exact 2×2, eight-way, increasing-k arithmetic and conservative FMA rules. The new layout reduces cache traffic and active memory streams without changing per-element arithmetic or output representation, so it is intended to supply the isolated matrix gain needed to clear the 1.4775 one-task threshold.
